regex1.text: Regex workbench (Tools, Developer tools). Shows the pattern editor with flags, the twelve sections, the token palette with engine-disabled tokens, the explanation tree, match and capture highlighting, the step debugger and the time-limit stop for catastrophic patterns. Try: flag chips, the section tabs, Try a catastrophic pattern. Unbuilt: editable code templates, folder GREP and replace in files with backups, command line integration, layout preferences.

regex2.text: Regex builder beside a search field. Each field owns its pattern, flags, history and snippets. A risky pattern is not run until the person allows it. Try: the .* regex button, the (a+)+ chip for the risk gate, proof-\d to go back. Unbuilt here: the builder on fields that do not use the shared search box.
